description: The in-app browser's live-page windows (`browser-*`). It grants NOTHING and that is its entire content — it exists so the label is named in one place and so widening it is a visible diff rather than an accidental match of some other capability's glob. `local` is false as the belt to the braces of `remote` being absent — but note its limit: it governs plugin permissions only. The app's own `#[tauri::command]`s have no ACL manifest (build.rs defines none), and Tauri 2 checks an app command's ACL only for a remote origin, so a browsed page that ever reached an origin Tauri calls local could invoke every app command (mail_draft_send included) whatever this file says. What actually keeps `browser-*` out is the navigation gate refusing tauri:/ipc:/data:/blob: and Tauri refusing app commands from remote origins. Every defence around it is described in docs/browser_plan_b.md §2; the regression guard is src-tauri/tests/capability_scope.rs.
